result:
I added the Teams page and the create-team API and mock handler in `apps/react-vite`. I did not run tests, lint, type check or the app, so none of it has been run.

- **API:** `src/features/teams/api/create-team.ts` has a Zod schema with a required name and description, and a `POST /teams` fetcher. It also has a `useCreateTeam` hook that refreshes the teams list after saving.
- **Mock handler:** `POST /teams` in `src/testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts` requires sign-in and admin, creates the team and saves it to the mock database.
- **Teams page:** `/app/teams` shows a table of name, description and creation date. A Create Team button opens a form drawer. It shows a "Team Created" success toast after saving. The page is admin-only.
- **Navigation:** I added a Teams link to the side navigation, shown to admins only. The path is in `config/paths.ts` and the route is in `app/router.tsx`.
- **New files:** `features/teams/components/create-team.tsx`, `features/teams/components/teams-list.tsx` and `app/routes/app/teams.tsx`.

Things to check:
- **Not tested:** I added no integration test, although the repo expects one for new behaviour.
- **Team scoping:** `GET /teams` returns every team and is also used by registration. The new page therefore lists other teams' names to any admin, which goes against the product rule that users only see their own team. The product notes put a Teams page for admins of several teams on the roadmap as not started. You asked for all teams, so I built it that way.
- **New team membership:** A new team has no members, because a user belongs to exactly one team and there is no way to move users. The admin who creates a team stays in their own.
- **Error status:** Non-admins get a 500 with "Unauthorized" from the mock handler, matching the existing handlers.
